title: The Iron Assembly: Crown of Ash and Oaths
description: A political intrigue adventure of rival houses, public unrest, secret deals, and a kingdom on the edge of civil war.
intro:
The kingdom of Valedorne has survived plague, famine, and border war, but it may not survive its own council chamber.

The old king is dead. No clear heir has taken the throne. The noble houses gather inside the Iron Assembly to bargain, threaten, and betray one another while riots spread beyond the palace walls. You are sent into the heart of the capital as a trusted but expendable envoy. To prevent collapse, you must navigate alliances, uncover conspiracies, recover stolen proofs, and decide which vision of the realm deserves to endure.

This showcase adventure emphasizes politics, diplomacy, investigation, elite and common factions, branching-feeling quest lines, NPC interaction, strategic combat, and story-rich exploration.

rooms.name: Assembly Forecourt
rooms.description: A broad marble approach to the royal senate, crowded with petitioners, heralds, and armed retainers trying not to stare one another down. Banners of rival houses hang above the columns, each claiming duty to the realm while eyeing the throne.

rooms.name: Hall of Delegates
rooms.description: Dozens of benches curve toward a raised speaker’s dais where decrees and denunciations alike are delivered with polished fury. Courtiers move in little constellations of gossip, and every smile looks carefully measured.

rooms.name: Public Petition Arcade
rooms.description: Common folk line up beneath iron arches to plead for grain relief, guard support, and justice. Scribes race from table to table with ink-stained fingers while city guards try to maintain order.

rooms.name: Envoys' Cloister
rooms.description: A cloistered corridor of foreign emblems, quiet alcoves, and veiled negotiations. Ambassadors pace here with interpreters and bodyguards, each waiting for signs of which faction will seize momentum.

rooms.name: Speaker's Rotunda
rooms.description: Bronze braziers burn with perfumed oil around a circular chamber where the kingdom’s most important speeches have shaped decades of law. Every whisper in the rotunda seems amplified by its perfect acoustics.

rooms.name: Archive of Statutes
rooms.description: Tall lacquered shelves hold treaties, census ledgers, court rulings, and tax charters that define the kingdom more truly than any crown. Dust, candle wax, and old vellum cling to the still air.

rooms.name: Whip Room
rooms.description: Not a chamber of punishment, but of political counting. Wax tablets, seat tallies, and compromise drafts cover every table, revealing just how fragile every coalition has become.

rooms.name: Bread Square
rooms.description: The market district beyond the palace walls groans with frustration. Loaves are scarce, tempers are high, and several agitators shout that the Assembly has forgotten the people entirely.

rooms.name: Embassy Garden
rooms.description: A walled garden of clipped hedges, stone fountains, and narrow winding paths. It is beautiful enough to calm suspicion for a moment, which is exactly why so many secret meetings happen here.

rooms.name: Council Gallery
rooms.description: Portraits of former regents and assembly speakers line this long upper gallery, all watching over the latest succession crisis with oil-painted disappointment. The floorboards creak beneath every private approach.

rooms.name: Sealed Records Vault
rooms.description: Here lie succession contracts, intelligence reports, and scandalous confessions locked away from public view. Some cabinets stand open already, and missing seals hint that someone got here first.

rooms.name: Cinder Stair
rooms.description: A spiral stair links the garden, strategy rooms, and high chambers where real power is traded when the formal speeches are done. Fresh soot stains the walls from a recent, unexplained fire.

rooms.name: Crow Tribune
rooms.description: An open platform overlooking the city where orators whip the crowd into hope, rage, or disciplined resolve. Whoever controls this square can shape the mood of the capital in a single afternoon.

rooms.name: Chamber of the Empty Throne
rooms.description: The ceremonial throne sits under a canopy of steel feathers, untouched since the king’s death. Representatives of every faction claim to defend the realm, but their eyes never leave the seat at the center of the room.

rooms.name: Shadow Ledger Cellar
rooms.description: A hidden cellar beneath the tribunal storing slush funds, false petitions, forged decrees, and enough blackmail to unmake a dynasty. Damp stone and sealed crates make the air close and dangerous.

rooms.name: Hall of Final Vote
rooms.description: This narrow, intimidating chamber is where the last formal tally will decide the realm’s direction. Armed honor guards stand beneath hanging lamps while every faction delivers its final arguments under enormous strain.

items.name: Envoy's Signet
items.description: A ring proving that you carry delegated authority within the Assembly grounds.

items.name: Ceremonial Rapier
items.description: A dueling blade favored by noble retainers; graceful, quick, and made for narrow chambers.

items.name: Speaker's Notes
items.description: Margin annotations reveal which houses are wavering and which speeches were meant only for public theater.

items.name: Petition Roll
items.description: Hundreds of citizen signatures begging the Assembly to release grain stores before unrest becomes revolt.

items.name: Diplomat's Cloak
items.description: A formal traveling cloak trimmed in sober silver, offering modest protection and a strong impression.

items.name: Tonic of Composure
items.description: A bitter herbal draft used by overworked clerks, negotiators, and those about to face hostile assemblies.

items.name: Succession Abstract
items.description: A legal summary of the old king’s final amendments, heavily marked by several different hands.

items.name: Seal of Appeal
items.description: A stamped medallion authorizing access to emergency council hearings.

items.name: Vote Ledger
items.description: A whip count showing exactly how many delegates may still be convinced to switch sides.

items.name: Bread Token
items.description: A stamped ration token accepted by hungry families and black-market brokers alike.

items.name: Whisperwine Flask
items.description: A refined cordial that takes the edge off long conspiracies and longer evenings.

items.name: Gallery Pass
items.description: A bronze pass permitting its bearer to walk the upper galleries during formal debate.

items.name: Inheritance Codex
items.description: A sealed legal compendium whose contents could legitimize one claimant and ruin another.

items.name: Cinder Key
items.description: A scorched iron key dropped during a hurried escape up the inner stair.

items.name: Orator's Script
items.description: A speech crafted to inflame public outrage with just enough truth to feel righteous.

items.name: Crown Writ
items.description: A ceremonial decree template awaiting the name of whoever will rule next.

items.name: Shadow Accounts
items.description: Proof of bribery, illicit grain deals, and secret payments to agitators across the capital.

items.name: Ash Crown Fragment
items.description: A relic from the old coronation regalia, symbolizing the burden of rule more than its glory.

items.name: Guard Halberd
items.description: A long court halberd carried by the Assembly’s elite honor guard.

monsters.name: Chancellor Serin Vale
monsters.description: The acting head of the Assembly: poised, measured, and carrying the exhaustion of someone holding a kingdom together by will alone.

monsters.name: People's Tribune Maelor
monsters.description: A fiery reform speaker beloved by the square and distrusted by half the nobility.

monsters.name: Lady Yselle of House Marr
monsters.description: An aristocratic power broker whose calm courtesy conceals a ruthless talent for coalition building.

monsters.name: Archive Clerk Tovan
monsters.description: A nervous records keeper who knows too much and trusts too few people still standing.

monsters.name: Riot Agitator
monsters.description: A sharp-eyed instigator armed with slogans, stones, and a very profitable sense of outrage.

monsters.name: Blackmail Broker Vey
monsters.description: A fixer in immaculate gloves who sells scandal to every faction while pretending allegiance to none.

monsters.name: Honor Guard Captain
monsters.description: A disciplined royal officer determined to prevent the chamber from descending into open bloodshed.

monsters.name: Usurper's Champion
monsters.description: A heavily armored enforcer working for the faction willing to seize the throne by force if persuasion fails.

quests.title: Count the Houses
quests.description: Recover the voting ledger and reach the strategy chambers so the Assembly can see where power truly stands.

quests.title: Expose the Hidden Purse
quests.description: Track down the shadow accounts and put an end to the broker profiting from unrest in the capital.

quests.title: Secure the Final Vote
quests.description: Reach the last chamber of decision and prevent the usurper’s champion from breaking the Assembly by force.

objectives.description: Reach the Hall of Final Vote
